title: Daily AI
intro: Five questions about this corner of the internet. Choose one and my homelab generates an answer live, using a local model and public sources from this site.
policy: Five generations per IP per day, with a shared limit of 50 generations per day. Both reset at midnight Beijing time. Refreshing reopens your latest answer without using another request. Shared networks share an allowance.
aiNotice: These answers are generated by AI, are written in English, and may be inaccurate. Check the linked sources.
banPolicy: This feature permanently bans IPs that send malformed AI requests or use curl/Python user agents. Bans can be removed by the site owner.
pending: The homelab is offline or unavailable. Please come back later.
banned: This IP is banned from Daily AI. Contact the site owner if you need the ban reviewed.
limit: This IP has used all five generations today. Refresh to reopen the latest answer.
trafficLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute before trying again.
timeout: The request timed out. Refresh to check whether your selection was accepted.
fullSite: Open the full site to choose a question
generationFailed: Generation stopped or the connection was interrupted. You can retry a failed generation.
thinkingNotice: Generated by the local model and shown as received. This may contain mistakes and does not verify the answer.
globalLimit: The shared limit of 50 generations has been reached for today. New generations resume at midnight Beijing time.
durationNote: Time spent on the model requests, including loading and prompt processing. Queueing is excluded.
speedNote: Model generation speed, including thinking and answer tokens. Loading and prompt processing are excluded.
tokensNote: Actual tokens reported by Ollama, including thinking and any answer-only pass.
outputTruncated: The answer reached its output limit and may be incomplete.
errorEmptyAnswer: The model finished without an answer. Your allowance is refunded; please try again.
errorStreamIncomplete: The model stream ended unexpectedly. Your allowance is refunded; please try again.
errorOutputLimit: The model exceeded its output limit. Your allowance is refunded; please try again.
errorModelUnavailable: The local model became unavailable. Your allowance is refunded; please try again later.
errorGenerationTimeout: Generation exceeded its time limit. Your allowance is refunded; please try again.
errorRunnerDisconnected: The homelab connection was interrupted. Your allowance is refunded; please try again.
errorCancelled: Generation was cancelled by the site controls. Your allowance is refunded.
